name: Lifetite Metal Products, LLC
old_description: LifeTite Metal Products is a manufacturer of premium metal roofing, metal siding and trim
about:
Lifetite Metal Products, LLC operates three roll-forming and fabrication facilities in Kenna, Belington, and Mt. Hope, West Virginia. Established in Kenna, the independently owned company has expanded to serve the broader region with premium metal roofing, siding, and trim components for residential, commercial, and agricultural markets.

The company’s core processes include custom fabrication and roll forming, supported by equipment such as a Thalmann Double Folder TD 200 and board-and-batten machines. Across its three West Virginia plants, Lifetite manufactures insulated metal building panels alongside standard roofing and siding profiles, offering a range of profiles for metal buildings.

Customers range from homeowners and local contractors to agricultural operators and commercial builders. The company serves the residential, commercial, and agriculture sectors directly, with testimonials noting next-day order readiness and a 72-hour turnaround on custom work.

Lifetite emphasizes material quality as the foundation of a durable roof, promoting benefits such as a 50-year lifespan, energy efficiency through reflective coatings, and recyclability. Its stated differentiators are premium products, fast service (72 hours or less), and custom fabrication to specification.
